newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-EDI unit wins W. Australia loco order.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-EDI unit wins W. Australia loco order.

text.p: Evans Deakin Industries Ltd unit Clyde Industries Ltd had won a contract to supply an extra six locomotives to the government-owned Westrail, Western Australian Transport Minister Eric Charlton said on Wednesday.
The contract takes the total number of locomotives being built by Clyde for Westrail to 30 and increases the contract's total value to A$88 million, Charlton said in a statement.
Clyde would build the locomotives at Forrestfield in Western Australia, employing more than 100 people, he said.
"In all, 19 4,000-horsepower standard gauge and 11 3,000-horsepower narrow gauge locomotives will be assembled at the Forrestfield facility," Charlton said.
Deliveries will start in the middle of this year and be completed by April 1998.
Clyde successfully tendered in June last year to build 24 diesel electric locomotives for Westrail.
